title: Creating My Own Trading Bot Powered with Machine Learning! (E/e Andoid Process)
author: No_Car1901
selftext:
Nothing to do this diwali. Just getting bored in Bangalore.

So I got this idea why not create a setup of ai agents.

So I found this repo. Connected this with my bot and connected the ai agents to Binance. So now I have 20 ai agents working on a single module.

Each agent will study the 90 day history of the top 20 pairs. 

So the repo was basic level. I added some cherries to it. They will study on three different timeframes then apply the best strategy to it.and comes up with the perfect entry and exit strategy.

I kept it simple for now. 

I'll backtest the setup for atleast 100 trades. In backtesting I'm giving it 1000usdt. We'll see how it Will work. 

🤞

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: it's good that you plan to backtest before using real money. 100 trades is a small sample though, so I'd treat the result as a first look and not proof. Since the agents study 90 days of history, I'd also test them on days they never saw, otherwise the result mostly shows how well they fit the past. And make sure fees are in, because they matter a lot on small accounts. Cymetica's Backtest Labs includes fees and can hold out the last part of the history for that kind of check.
